messages:
Jordan C.: hey team, quick help please — my chronic back pain flared and sitting at the open bench is painful. doc recommended an ergonomic chair + occasional private room for focused work. also i have several physio appts next month during core hours. what's the process to request this as an accommodation?
Priya (People Ops): sorry to hear that, Jordan. you can start by sending a note from your clinician (DM to me is fine). we usually offer temporary ergonomic equipment and priority for private room bookings while we evaluate.
Jordan C.: thanks — i can DM the note. curious if the private room is likely to be approved quickly? my appts are recurring (Wednesdays 1-3pm) so i'd prefer a standing booking if possible.
Cam L. (Manager): i can support the standing booking if people ops okays it. reminder that we have team standup at 1:30p on Weds; Jordan, would swapping that to 11a for that day work?
Jordan C.: swapping works for me. i'm worried about perf review timing — i have deliverables this cycle but physio + pain may reduce PF during a few sprints. will accommodations affect evaluation?
Priya (People Ops): accommodations don't penalize you. we log the accommodation period in confidential records and flag it to reviewers as context. if you want, we can add a note to your manager guidance doc about focusing on outcomes rather than strict hours for the next 8 weeks.
hr-bot: Equipment request form created: EQ-20261105-7. Please allow 3-5 business days for ergonomic chair procurement.
Cam L. (Manager): i'll update sprint expectations with the team and redistribute a couple of tasks to cover high-latency work. Jordan, if you prefer, we'll shift your reviews to outcome checkpoints instead of time-based check-ins for this cycle.
Jordan C.: appreciate that. one more ask: can the private room booking be limited to just the facilities team and me? i don't want folks creating drama over it.
Priya (People Ops): yes — bookings are private and we only share necessary info. we'll keep the accommodation notes restricted to you, Cam, and People Ops.
Jordan C.: DM sent with the clinician note. thanks all.
Priya (People Ops): got it — case ID PO-20261105-77. we'll follow up with an accommodation memo and arrange the chair + room reservations. meeting scheduled to confirm details: 2026-11-06 09:30 with Jordan, Cam, and Priya.
Jordan C.: confirmed. thanks :pray:
_meta: Slack thread about requesting ergonomic equipment, private room bookings, physio appointments, and clarifying how accommodations affect performance reviews. Contains equipment request bot and meeting scheduling.
